title: Northgate Business Card Bonus on Business Cash Earnings
content:
**Bonus.** Under the Business earning schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, a line paid with a Northgate Business card adds percentage points to the Business earning percentage of the line the schedule settles. The payment method and the paying card account are those recorded on the order line; the account's tier and status are those on Northgate Card Credit Accounts (issued by Harbor Point Bank, N.A.).

| Line paid with a Northgate Card whose account is | Account status | Points added |
|---|---|---|
| a Northgate Business Mastercard | active | 0.5 |
| a Northgate Business Store Card | active | 0.25 |
| any card account not in active status, a consumer Northgate Card tier, or a line not paid with a Northgate Card | — | none |

**Hypothetical illustration.** An office-supply line paid with an active Northgate Business Store Card carries 0.25 added percentage points; the same line paid with an external card carries none.
